blocks.text: Aap kitab ke safhon ki tadaad bilkul theek gin sakte hain, magar us ki lambai napne ko napne wala instrument chahiye. Har instrument kisi khaas sab se chhote division ke nishan tak calibrate hota hai, aur yeh baat us ki durustagi (accuracy) par had lagati hai: jab aap kisi instrument se reading lete hain to us ki paimaish ki had us ke scale ka sab se chhota division ya graduation hoti hai. Is liye har napi gayi quantity ki qeemat mein kuch ghair-yaqeeni (uncertainty) hoti hai. Jab paimaish ki jati hai to woh scale ke qareeb tareen nishan tak li jati hai, aur zyada se zyada uncertainty instrument ke ek sab se chhote division ke barabar andaza ki ja sakti hai.

blocks.title: Absolute uncertainty
blocks.text: Reading mein zyada se zyada uncertainty, jo instrument ke ek sab se chhote division ke barabar andaza ki jati hai, absolute uncertainty hai. Millimetre mein graduated metre rule par yeh ek millimetre hai.

Maslan, agar kitab ka ek kinara 10.0 cm ke nishan par aur doosra 33.5 cm par ho, to lambai apni uncertainty ke saath (33.5 +/- 0.05) cm - (10.0 +/- 0.05) cm = (23.5 +/- 0.1) cm hai. Kitab ki asal lambai 23.4 cm aur 23.6 cm ke darmiyan hai; har sire par zyada se zyada uncertainty +/-0.05 cm hai, jo lambai mein 0.1 cm ki uncertainty ke barabar hai, aur yeh metre rule ke least count ke barabar hai.

blocks.title: Fractional aur percentage uncertainty
blocks.text: Fractional uncertainty = absolute uncertainty / napi gayi qeemat. Percentage uncertainty = (absolute uncertainty / napi gayi qeemat) x 100.

Kuch jadeed napne wale instruments ka digital scale hota hai. Hum aam taur par yaqeeni se ek hindsa aage andaza karte hain; digital scale par yeh aakhri hindse ke kuch utaar charhao (fluctuation) mein nazar aata hai. Agar aakhri hindsa 1 ya 2 se badle to woh aakhri hindsa likh lein. Agar aakhri hindse mein utaar charhao 2 ya us se zyada ho to reading par hawa ke jhonkon jaise kisi amil ka asar ho raha hai; wajah jo bhi ho, bara utaar charhao ka matlab ho sakta hai ke dikhaya gaya hindsa dar asal significant nahi. Record shuda qeemat mein uncertainty ki nishandahi significant figures se aasan kar di gayi hai: agar paimaish significant figures ke ilm ke saath record ho to us ka aakhri hindsa, jo andaza hai, record shuda qeemat ki accuracy batata hai.

blocks.caption: Uncertainty bayan karne ke teen tareeqe
header: Kitab ki misal (metre rule se 23.5 cm)

blocks.prompt: Ek digital balance lagatar readings mein 24.36 g, 24.37 g, 24.36 g dikhata hai, aur doosra 24.3, 24.9, 24.1 g. Har soorat mein kya record hona chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Pehla display aakhri hindse mein sirf 1 badalta hai, to aakhri hindsa rakha jata hai: 24.36 g (ya 24.37 g) taqreeban 0.01 g ki uncertainty ke saath. Doosra aakhri hindse mein 2 se kahin zyada badalta hai, to hawa ke jhonkon jaisi koi cheez use hila rahi hai aur aakhri hindsa significant nahi; reading 24 g di jaye, ya record karne se pehle wajah hatai jaye.

items: Har instrument apne sab se chhote division tak parhta hai; absolute uncertainty ek least count hai (metre rule par 1 mm). Fractional = absolute / qeemat; percentage = fractional x 100.
Kitab ki lambai: (33.5 +/- 0.05) - (10.0 +/- 0.05) = (23.5 +/- 0.1) cm. Digital scales: 1 ya 2 se badalne wala aakhri hindsa rakhein; bara utaar charhao matlab woh significant nahi.
